sentences.text: Augustasaurus was estimated to be between 2.5 and 3 meters long and weighed 100 kilograms.
Its skull featured an elongated rostrum tapering to a dull point and fang-like anterior teeth.
The animal possessed low dorsal neural spines with rugose tops.
Augustasaurus possessed large coracoid plates similar to those found in other plesiosaurs, yet it lacked coracoid foramina, a trait also seen in the pistosauroid Corosaurus.
It had cervical ribs with anterior processes and vertebrae with thickened transverse processes.
The holotype skeleton of Augustasaurus was partly destroyed by weathering after discovery.
The first fossil of Augustasaurus was discovered in 1993 in Muller Canyon within the Augusta Mountains of Nevada.
Augustasaurus was described in 1997 from fossils found in the Favret Formation in Pershing County, Nevada, USA.
Paleontologists Paul Martin Sander, Olivier Cedric Rieppel, and Hugo Bucher named the species Augustasaurus hagdorni.
The genus name Augustasaurus means "Augusta lizard", combining the type locality name with the Greek word for lizard.
The species name hagdorni honors the German paleontologist Hans Hagdorn.
A second study published in 2002 described the skull of Augustasaurus, which was recovered shortly after the initial skeleton discovery.
Augustasaurus possessed fang-like teeth adapted for eating fish and squid.
The ecosystem where Augustasaurus lived had well-aerated surface waters but few animals in the benthic zones.
Ichthyosaurs, including apex predators like Thalattoarchon and Cymbospondylus, were the most abundant marine reptiles in Augustasaurus's habitat.
Augustasaurus is classified as a pistosauroid.
Augustasaurus belongs to the Pistosauroidea clade, which includes ancestors of plesiosaurs.
Recent studies classify Augustasaurus as the sister taxon to Plesiosauria rather than within Pistosauridae, considering it an advanced pistosauroid and the sister group to the order Plesiosauria.
Augustasaurus shares a common ancestor with future plesiosaurs based on its postcranial anatomy.
Augustasaurus lived during the Anisian stage of the Middle Triassic in what is now North America.
Early classifications placed Augustasaurus in the family Pistosauridae as a sister taxon to Pistosaurus.
